newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama to issue $500 mln in Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Panama to issue $500 mln in Eurobonds.

text.p: The Panamian government plans to issue $500 million worth of Eurobonds, according to an official decree published Friday.
A cabinet of ministers resolution published in the Official Gazette said Panama had instructed the Bank of Boston Trust Co Bahamas Ltd to handle the issue on the government's behalf.
The Eurobonds will have a maturity of five years and a rate of interest no more than 300 basis points above that of U.S. treasury bonds, the resolution said.
The resolution did not say when the issue would take place.
